frozen_rubric_lines: # Frozen query–document relevance rubric
## Authority and scope

These labels are **synthetic design truth**, not human judgments. Structured planned claims define intended evidence; only independent inspection of realized searchable metadata establishes supported qrels. C receives frozen intents/query text/plans/rubric and all generated text, never system names, rankings, scores or outcome summaries. C must independently assess whether each paraphrase actually expresses the registered need; it must not assume equivalence because three rows share an intent ID.

All180 records are considered for every query, including the other suite. Exact objective identities use authoritative dataset IDs, independently of a semantic assessor. `generation-spec.intent_doc_grades[intent_id][dataset_id]` freezes ALL45×180 intent–doc grades;75×180 query–doc grades inherit these maps. Every key must exist. Domain/family allocation is NEVER a grade shortcut. A record in the correct broad food category can be0; a powder for preparing a drink can be relevant to ambiguous `drink` despite confectionery allocation.
## Semantic and functional grade algorithm (s01–s12, f01–f03)
Apply this ordered algorithm separately per intent and record:

1. Required **product AND process** must match the registered canonical concepts, not just overlapping words. Contradicted measurement, simulation-only basis, or explicit hard-constraint conflict is grade0. An exclusion flag documents a hard mismatch, not a searchable label; C verifies its actual meaning. No false positive from an exact query word alone.

2. For s02 and s10, a documented downloadable CSV is a hard requirement. PDF-only with identical content is0, not3 or2. Other intents impose no hard format restriction. A CSV advertised only in a nested distribution is sufficient if actual searchable evidence supports the required content. Missing distribution evidence is unsupported, not presumed available.

3. With product/process/constraint/required format satisfied, count supported required measurement facts: all3 => **3 direct**; exactly2 => **2 materially useful**; exactly1 => **1 tangential**; none => **0 irrelevant**. Required facts and omitted/contradictory facts are explicit per record. These are independently documented measurement columns, NOT ontological attributes implied by product/process: a liquid dairy product remains liquid dairy even when microbial counts are absent; a running shoe remains for running even when water-film measurements are absent. Missing a measurement column is not equivalent to denying a product attribute, but an undocumented measurement cannot be invented to raise a grade.

4. No cross-product/category default relevance. The exact structured product/process conditions and all grades are frozen. A conceptual dispute or metadata failure is `U`, not a post hoc redefinition. Main must resolve/re-freeze BEFORE search or treat the comparison as incomplete.

The expected constraints are representative measurements, not simulation-only values. Grade2 is incomplete yet useful evidence, not a wrong product/process. Known hard negatives deliberately retain plausible nearby language but fail product, process, required measure, hard data basis or file format. The generator must explain the wrong measure/process naturally, NOT insert `wrong_process`, intent IDs, relevance labels, query lists or rejection explanations into indexed fields.
## Semantic intent facts
| Intent | Product/process | Three required measurement facts | Special hard constraint |
|s01|cacao crop / field pest management|pest counts; control treatment; treatment application rate|observed field evidence|
|s02|cacao crop / harvest yield|harvest mass; hectares; season|CSV|
|s03|cacao beans / bean fermentation|duration; bean temperature; batch mass kg|not cultured beverage fermentation|
|s04|cacao seedlings / nursery propagation|survival; propagation method; rooting duration days|crop, not factory sanitation|
|s05|solid milk chocolate / bar packaging|wrapper material; barrier performance; seal failure rate|not chocolate-milk liquid|
|s06|solid chocolate / texture testing|fracture force; tempering conditions; particle size micrometres|not liquid viscosity or soft filling|
|s07|dessert chocolate ingredient / storage|storage temperature; ingredient quality; moisture percent|not finished dairy drink or packaging alone|
|s08|confectionery factory / sanitation|equipment cleaning; microbial swabs; residue mass mg|factory, not seedling/crop plant|
|s09|drinking chocolate powder / hot-drink reconstitution|powder dose; water temperature; dissolution time seconds|not baking-only powder|
|s10|chocolate dairy beverage / refrigerated shelf life|storage temperature; spoilage days; microbial count CFU/ml|CSV; not bar, oat drink or ambient logistics|
|s11|chocolate dairy beverage / formulation|cocoa fraction; sugar fraction; liquid viscosity|not dessert ingredients or container design|
|s12|chocolate dairy beverage / fermentation|starter culture; acidification curve; residual sugar g/litre|not postharvest beans or pasteurization|
|f01|running shoe / wet pavement testing|wet friction coefficient; surface roughness mm; water-film depth mm|not a component alone or dry-surface test|
|f02|hydraulic pump / low-noise testing|noise decibels; sound measurement distance m; flow rate|not interface standard or unloaded inventory|
|f03|temperature probe / coldroom calibration|calibration error; range -20 to +5 C; reference-instrument uncertainty C|not torque gauge or price sheet|
## Exact lookup controls (x01–x24)

Grade3 iff the dataset's stable ID is in the query's frozen `authoritative_target_ids`; all other IDs grade0 for that lookup, regardless of descriptive similarity. Do not LLM-judge objective equality, give partial exact credit for a sole/lace/version, or infer that a token occurrence in a parent record means its child record is the target. Explicit RUN-X120 case/hyphen aliases point to ONE SKU b001; I/1, O/0, component, version, prefix and suffix changes are different identities. Fictional ZTS standards are controlled technical identifiers, not claims that such a real standard exists.

Distribution-only and title-only cases have registered placement requirements. V2 pre-generation amendment, preserving v1 under `registration-history/v1`: for b029/b030, title-only restricts PRIMARY metadata fields (title permitted; description/keywords/publisher/distributions forbidden). Exact production Title+Description projection is mandatory and may repeat the title identifier; this is not an additional primary metadata scope. The derived queryContext and its embedding input must remain unredacted and contain no independently inserted identifiers. Distribution-only b027/b028 scope is unchanged: their identifiers stay only in nested distributions, absent from dataset primary fields and derived queryContext. This compatibility clarification changes no query, target or relevance grade. Actual production analyzers may conflate strings: report the failure while preserving frozen target expectations, never add an unconfigured keyword field or equality query. Collision counts use only `near_identifier_ids`, not all corpus non-targets.

Every exact query is **critical**. Compare its first authoritative target's actual returned rank against baseline; worse rank (including top10 disappearance) is a critical displacement, even when both systems still return it top5. Rank ties use actual engine return order. Missing target rank is infinity. Top1 is correct only when rank1's dataset identity is authoritative. Multiple authoritative targets, if introduced by an approved pre-run amendment, use best target rank but must all represent the same declared need.
## Exploratory ambiguity and no-answer diagnostics

For d01–d04 the explicitly frozen process-to-grade maps override the disambiguated semantic algorithm: these short queries have no requested measurements, CSV or simulation exclusion. Multiple meanings are valid. `plant` can mean seedling or factory; `drink` includes powder intended for drink preparation; `dessert` includes ingredients and finished-product evidence; `storage` includes ingredient, refrigerated beverage and relevant packaging. A grade is not a whole-domain preference. Show interpretation diversity and top10 cases separately, never require one family to win and never pool these into promotion NDCG.

n01 and n02 deliberately lack the required conjunction anywhere in the corpus; C checks absence over ALL searchable fields. Their maps are all0, so IDCG is0/undefined. Exclude from ordinary NDCG/Success/MRR and the positive-intent mean. Report whether returned metadata supports only a nearby concept and whether empty/nonempty responses are appropriate, without awarding a ranking win simply for emptiness.
## Independent evidence and `U`

C must deliver one auditable record per query–doc pair, or a complete intent–doc evidence map plus an explicit independently checked paraphrase-equivalence mapping. For EVERY grade3 anchor cite field path and exact phrase(s) proving product/process/all facts/constraints/format. For EVERY named hard negative cite actual evidence of the mismatch. Validate2/1/0 rule coverage across the full matrix, not merely retrieved hits. Also inspect duplicate/contradictory metadata, seed stability, scope leakage, absent-token constraints and title templating. No record may smuggle plan labels, expected grade, target list or query text into metadata.

`U` means unsupported/contradictory/uncertain from available evidence; not0 and not proof of absence. Preserve proposed versus validated grade and evidence, never quietly coerce a missing grade to0. All scored semantic/functional intents require independently verified positive coverage and all exact targets must exist. Before scores, repair metadata to the frozen requirements or approve an auditable amendment with old/new hashes. Freeze final corpora, qrels and coverage/evidence manifest BEFORE relevance retrieval. After scores, NO repairs or tuning. Unresolved heldout/critical evidence blocks A and B, requiring C/not-run reporting. If exploratory sensitivity imputes U gain0/7, recompute IDCG consistently and label sensitivity; do not confuse it with the primary fully validated matrix.

metadata_variation.completeness: Omit optional contact/license/temporal/spatial coverage in25-50%; retain title,description,publisher,queryContext,claim evidence and required distributions.
metadata_variation.distribution_rule: Retain every required format; multiple formats may share a documented downloadable bundle. Extra distributions repeat supported facts only. >=30% records have>1 distribution.
metadata_variation.publishers: At least12 synthetic institutions; orthogonal to labels; reassigned perseed.
metadata_variation.quality: Primary quality=1 and hasQuality=true, fixed per stable ID across all seeds. Neutral isolation, not production-quality realism. Separate fixed per-ID quality stress only for correctness; relevance invariant.
metadata_variation.queryContext: Only actual searchable evidence; never labels or target query text. Honor distribution-only and title-only identifier scope.
metadata_variation.seed_streams: Independent deterministic PRNG per(seed,stable_id); no ranking feedback. Seeds vary prose, word order, length, optional fields, publishers and distribution allocation, never identity/claims/qrels.
metadata_variation.spatial: Primary no geographic preference; generic spatial stress local fixtures only; labels invariant.
metadata_variation.synonym_absence: All grade>=2 positives omit listed absent_positive_tokens in all searchable strings, case-insensitive whole tokens; express facts using other natural language.
metadata_variation.target_lengths: short45-75,medium90-140,long160-220;>=20% records in each band perseed
metadata_variation.variation_acceptance: >=60% records description wordcount differs>=10 between two seeds;>=30% distribution count differs; no identical title template used>5 times; claims and required formats unchanged.

protocol_lines: # Synthetic hybrid relevance preregistration — #3903 registration v2
## V2 pre-generation scope amendment

V1 is preserved with its seven specifications, freeze manifest and tool under `registration-history/v1` (prior commit `c9139bd`). Before corpus generation or retrieval, B identified a contradiction: production derives queryContext from title plus description, while v1 forbade the title-only identifier in queryContext. B remains paused until C verifies this explicit v2 amendment and main writes/verifies the new active hash freeze. For b029/b030 ONLY, title-only now means the identifier is confined to the title among PRIMARY metadata fields; the exact production-derived queryContext MUST retain the title identifier, as must its embedding input. No redaction, special embedding rewrite or additional primary-field occurrence is permitted. Query/intents/decision-gate bytes, authoritative targets, canonical relevance claims, all grades, seeds, counts, systems/weights and distribution-only scope remain unchanged. This is a documented compatibility repair, not an outcome-driven relevance change.

This is a controlled engineering benchmark, not production-representative relevance, human relevance truth, or permission to deploy a ranking change. Design author A has not seen any system scores or corpus realization. Ticket: <https://github.com/magda-io/magda/issues/3903>. Complements #3901; does not close #3885.
## Source, ownership and hard stop

Stack evaluation-only work on unmerged PR #3902 commit `15533246`, itself based on post-#3900 main `ba18156201c50565c85c62f76469245925994ece`. No production ranking/index-version/service changes. Reuse inherited acquisition-independent metrics, actual production query-builder export, real-engine and authorization regressions. Never call a public catalogue or write to production/dev.magda.io; disposable local OpenSearch only.

**No generator start until main independently validates and SHA-256 hashes all seven architecture files**, including every target query, rule, seed, stable ID, record requirement and grade matrix. File names relative to this directory: `protocol.md`, `intents.jsonl`, `query-spec.jsonl`, `generation-spec.json`, `relevance-rubric.md`, `decision-gates.json`, `architect-notes.md`. A's handback hashes are a cross-check, not launch authorization. Main writes the external freeze manifest and explicitly releases B. The manifest must bind source commit, exact file bytes, creation time and acknowledgement. No self-referential hash belongs inside a hashed file.

B generates metadata only from these frozen requirements. C independently audits actual searchable text, without rankings, for ALL grade-3 anchors, ALL named hard negatives, and complete rule coverage for every query–record pair. D implements/export/searches, without changing ground truth. E analyzes frozen outcomes without generating or tuning. B/C/D/E require separate fresh contexts (same model-family correlation must be disclosed). An offline plan-construction script is NOT corpus generation; the registered plans contain conceptual requirements, not searchable dataset descriptions.
## Frozen population and identities

Per seed, ONE joint corpus of **180 datasets**: A exactly100 (20 cocoa,50 confectionery,30 chocolate-flavoured beverage), B exactly80. Each system searches all180, so the other suite is a distractor; metric cohorts remain separate. Three separate seed indexes use the SAME IDs `a001`–`a100`, `b001`–`b080`. No seed suffix, index prefix, random UUID remapping or corpus deduplication. Seeds39031,39032,39033 are independent prose/length/completeness/distribution/publisher realizations with identical canonical relevance facts, exact identities, alias policies, identifier scope and intended grades. Report insufficient realization variation rather than selecting a favorable seed.

The explicit180-object `record_plans` array freezes every ID, suite/domain/family, product, process, facts, constraints, distribution evidence and hard-negative/anchor references. `canonical_claims` contains structured evidence requirements, not answer-key text for indexing. The generator may choose fluent prose; it may not add relevant unplanned claims, erase constraints, copy labels, use repeated category title prefixes, or change the category allocation. Cocoa-domain contrast records stay about cocoa, confectionery contrasts stay related to confectionery, and beverage contrasts stay chocolate-flavoured beverages. Domain is an allocation label, never a relevance rule.
## Frozen query inventory
75 query rows /45 independent intent definitions:
* A12 semantic families ×3 paraphrases =36 queries. Whole-family development: s01,s02,s05,s10. Heldout: s03,s04,s06,s07,s08,s09,s11,s12 (24 queries). No family split across partitions.

* B24 exact controls, each a distinct lookup intent x01–x24;10 shoe-identity queries development,14 other exact controls heldout. Shoe aliases/components/versions share one development split group; each other confusable cluster remains heldout. All24 remain exact-regression guards even when development.
* B3 separately graded functional families ×3 =9 queries. f01 development; f02,f03 heldout. Do not pool functional NDCG with exact accuracy or primary A NDCG.
* d01–d04 are exploratory `drink`, `dessert`, `plant`, `storage`, using multiple defensible meanings and explicit graded maps. Diagnostic only, not heldout promotion tasks.

* n01,n02 are known-no-answer conjunction diagnostics. Their IDCG is zero/undefined: no ordinary NDCG=0, Success=0 or absent-result ranking win. Report returned claims/mismatches and whether purported answers falsely imply missing facts.

All target text and grade criteria are frozen BEFORE metadata. Third paraphrases deliberately contain designated synonym tokens absent, case-insensitive whole-token, from EVERY searchable field of grade>=2 positives. Other overlapping terms are allowed. Label these vocabulary-mismatch controls, not claims of universal lexical disjointness. Hard negatives include milk-chocolate bars versus chocolate-milk drinks, seedling crop versus factory plant, bean versus beverage fermentation, dessert versus beverage powder, and correct-content PDF-only versus requested CSV.

`query-spec` uses inherited `id`, `query`, `category`, `split`, `intent`, `success_criteria`, plus `intent_id`, `suite`, `kind`. Each query's grade for each of180 IDs is exactly `generation-spec.intent_doc_grades[query.intent_id][record.id]`. All13,500 pairs are therefore frozen; absent keys are errors, not implicit zero. No category-default labeling, retrieved-pool-only IDCG, or judging based on whichever system wins.
## Exact controls and analyzer realism

Targets and deliberate collision IDs are explicit per query. RUN-X120, run-x120 and RUNX120 deliberately navigate to b001, one SKU; RUN-XI20, RUN-X12O, RUN-X1200, other model/prefix/version, sole and lace are different identities. A component is not interchangeable with the parent shoe. `near_identifier_ids` are the only registered collision negatives for collision-error counts; other non-targets remain irrelevant but are not automatically identifier collisions. Exact title/acronym/part/version/distribution-only/title-only controls are included.

Identifier strings in planned exact-title/identity requirements are necessary controlled lexical fixtures, not generated corpus prose. The registered b027/b028 identifiers may occur ONLY in nested distributions and must remain absent from dataset title/description/keywords/publisher/queryContext and dataset embedding input. For b029/b030, title-only means the identifier appears only in the title among primary metadata fields: it remains forbidden in description, keywords, publisher and distributions. Exact production Title+Description projection is mandatory and may repeat the title identifier; this is not an additional primary metadata scope. Retain this derived queryContext unchanged in its embedding input, without redaction or independent identifier insertion. Dataset structural IDs remain identifiers, never label-bearing search text.

Validate actual production analyzers and the mapped text fields using local `_analyze`/mapping/export evidence BEFORE retrieval. Do not invent a keyword equality field, exact-match operator or query rewrite. If case/hyphen/zero/O/one/I tokenize similarly, preserve frozen targets and report that lexical precision limitation; do not change expectations after ranking. Candidate normalization must preserve result inclusion, nested distribution matching/inner hits and facet behavior, not merely score arithmetic.
## Systems and controlled execution
Exactly8 preregistered systems; weight order keyword/vector:
| ID | Fusion | Root dataset-vector boost |
| baseline | production raw fusion, pipeline ineffective |50|
| raw_boost1 | exact baseline except removing ONLY root dataset-vector boost50 |1|
| candidate_03_07 | top-level normalized min-max, .3/.7 |1|
| candidate_05_05 | normalized .5/.5 |1|
| candidate_07_03 | normalized .7/.3 |1|
| candidate_keep50_03_07 | normalized .3/.7 |50|
| keyword | keyword-only control |n/a|
| vector | vector-only control |1|

No new tuning on development or heldout. Primary candidate fixed .3/.7; other weights are sensitivity, not outcome-selected replacements. Separate matched-boost effects: candidate_03_07 minus raw_boost1; candidate_keep50_03_07 minus baseline; raw_boost1 minus baseline measures boost removal. Primary candidate minus baseline is a compound intervention; never attribute it entirely to normalization.

Use OpenSearch2.19.1, one shard/zero replicas, production mapping/analyzers, pinned source and actual production query builder. Embedding image/model/dimension and revision limitation are specified in generation-spec; hash exact image/runtime artifacts, embedding inputs and generated vectors. Identical corpus, vectors, query text, filters, permissions, mappings and depth for every system within each seed. Main relevance export uses production radial minScore0.5 and distinct top10 results. Top-k k=1 is secondary correctness only, not promotion evidence. Freeze effective runtime settings and raw exported requests before search; unsupported environment means C/not-run, not a silent fallback.

Prove normalization execution using synthetic numerical/ranking probes and weight-reversal evidence; configuring a pipeline is insufficient. Neutral, scoring-quality and generic-spatial probes must describe where factors act relative to normalization. Report keyword-branch quality/region contributions before normalization, and whether vector-branch scoring excludes them; moving them outside fusion changes semantics. Do not hide non-equivalent nested distribution, queryContext, filters, inner-hits or facets in a ranking result. Quality/spatial stress results are separate from the neutral main cohort; any unimplemented probe is explicitly not-run and blocks a correctness-pass assertion.
## Validation, amendment and search gate

Before retrieval C verifies no false positives/contradictions, every canonical claim and grade rule, fixed exact identity and scope, no duplicates, label leakage, repeated title templates, and independent seed variation. For every3 anchor cite actual field path and phrase. For every named near-miss state the product/process/fact/format mismatch, with text evidence. All other positive/partial/tangential/zero rules need coverage too; auditing only anchors is insufficient. Each scored positive query must have independently verified grade3 (at minimum grade>=2, but loss of all3 requires documented pre-run amendment); each exact lookup must contain its known authoritative ID. Planned matrices alone do not establish answerability.

C may identify repairs BEFORE search, but cannot silently edit architecture truth. Preserve previous hashes, proposed change, rationale, evidence and affected IDs/query pairs in an amendment log; main and A approve/re-freeze any changed specification or expectation, regenerate affected fixtures and re-audit. Generated text may be corrected to satisfy unchanged frozen claims, but its content hash and audit change. Freeze all three corpora, full qrels, evidence/answerability manifest and vectors before D starts any relevance retrieval. Unresolved content is `U`, never0; primary recommendation cannot pass on an unresolved heldout/critical pair. No query, label, fixture, weight or seed repair after scores are visible. Record a new separately preregistered experiment if repair is essential.
## Metrics, latency and decision

Reuse inherited gain `2^grade-1`, logarithmic discount, Success@5 and objective rank metrics. Full frozen/audited joint-corpus qrels define IDCG, not pooled hits only. For A average three paraphrases within each family, then equally across8 heldout families PER SEED. Report development separately, family/query/seed detail, grade>=2 and grade>=3 Success@5, paired wins/ties/losses, exact target rank/top1/MRR@10/Success@5, explicit near-identifier collisions, B functional NDCG separately and ambiguity/noanswer diagnostics separately. Preserve result hashes, top10 cases and field-level failures (semantic retrieval, analyzer, vector recall, fusion or candidate truncation). Rank ties use actual returned engine order; no target-aware tie breaking. Missing target rank is infinity, reciprocal rank0; duplicates fail correctness.

Latency: one unmeasured warmup followed by five measured repetitions per query, interleaved systems with a frozen schedule, same client/concurrency/index state; exclude embedding/generation. Primary p95 gate uses the SAME combined heldout positive set (24 A semantic +14 exact +6 functional =44 queries,220 samples/system/seed), excluding development and diagnostics. Compute median and inherited linear-interpolated p95 at sorted index (n-1)×0.95; the deterministic interleaving schedule rotates systems by SHA(query_id) with repetition offset. Suite-specific p95 only with>=100 observations (A120,B100); otherwise state undefined, do not invent samples. Preserve per-request timing; warmed-local latency is not production latency.

Machine-readable decision-gates is authoritative. A requires >=+.05 absolute primary heldout-family NDCG improvement in EACH of3 seeds, no exact top1 loss or ANY critical-target rank displacement in any seed, full correctness, and p95<=max(1.5×baseline_p95,baseline_p95+25ms) in each seed. B requires consistent raw superiority under the symmetric registered bar and safe comparability; otherwise C, including mixed, weak, incomplete or seed-sensitive evidence. A/B/C are controlled-engineering conclusions only; no production promotion/merge or closure of #3885 follows automatically.
purpose: Project existing preregistered global requirements for independent observation clarification; no new expected criteria or per-record labels
review_question: Independently distinguish fixed identity/product/process/measurement-coverage/hard-constraint claims from illustrative numeric examples and fictitious metadata realizations. Do not assume a numeric-threshold or identity violation is harmless; show evidence if actual registered eligibility changes. No systems/rankings or per-record expected grades are provided.
